title: Patch Remembered Another World

noob.caption: #FFD23F
noob.acting: bright, fast, cheerful cartoon character, impulsive and oblivious, great comic timing

steve.caption: #3FE0D0
steve.acting: calm, low, dry and deadpan; a practical survivor who rarely raises his voice

patch.caption: #B6F0FF
patch.acting: calm, literal, slightly too quiet; announces disasters politely

movie_note: Movie Episode 7 (the creator's 16:9 blueprint, 2026-11-27; story/movie/ep07_shots.md): picks up Ep6's cyan-white warp flash; the three tumble onto the Memory Grid; the hologram replay of the Noob dying on a kill-brick leaves a dark cube each time; the cubes rain down into a dark corrupted core (no Null shape); the past loop and the infinite pullback; Patch: '...I stopped counting.'; 'I don't want to be deleted.'; the void cracks the archive (REALITY 52 -> 30) and Patch warps them out to Steve's hidden portal (Ep8). Never back to the obby, Null never seen. The original takes (movie/ep07_published); one new take (Patch's 'It found the archive- I only have one stable coordinate left!').

voice_hall.note: the creator: the dialogue inside the Memory Grid in a subtle wide digital hall (decay 1.1 s, 12-15% wet, high-pass 250 Hz): an infinite hollow archive, so Ep8's forest feels physical

music.note: the melancholic piano/music-box bed of the archive (the published cue); the hit on the pullback; cut dead on the breach

ambience.note: Ep6's void wind goes on, cut under the landing

sfx.note: Ep6's warp chime (hit at Ep6's flash, 0.25 s before the cut): its tail rings on
the archive's faint electric room tone
the Noob flat on his back
the hologram breaks into glowing wireframe limbs
a heavy dark cube thuds onto the floor
the crystalline shatter (replaces the published whip-zing)
the hologram cells dissolving into black
Patch's warp chime, the same as Ep6's: rings over the cut into Ep8

events.note: Shot 1 (28 mm wide, low): Ep6's cyan-white flash fades down (the lens wash, cyan) onto the Memory Grid: a glowing blue translucent floor stretching into deep navy-cyan fog; the warp chime still ringing

Steve, the Noob and Patch tumble out of the warp onto the floor: Steve lands and drops to one knee (empty hands: no pickaxe), the Noob lands flat on his back, Patch wobbles in the air, steadying himself
Steve rises from his knee, looks round; the Noob hops up, fascinated, turning; Patch's eye adjusts (servo)
the Noob spots a glowing translucent hologram of himself 3 m ahead on a memory pad; it walks cheerfully toward a faint translucent red kill-brick

Shot 2 (35 mm medium-wide: the real pair left, the hologram right): hologram-Noob hops onto the kill-brick, shatters cleanly into glowing wireframe limbs, and one heavy pitch-black starry cube thuds onto the floor; a new hologram pops back up on the pad

events.name: noob_me
events.note: the original take; he points, raised brows, full lip-sync
the new hologram walks to the brick again; the second death, a second dark cube thuds down beside the first; cut on the thud

events.name: steve_what
events.note: the original take; Shot 3 (50 mm on Steve): he looks DOWN at the dark cubes on the floor (eye-line down, never into the lens)
Shot 4: a slow tilt down onto three trembling dark cubes on the glass pad; Patch drifts into frame beside them

events.name: patch_behind
events.text: Every time you respawn, something stays behind.
events.direction_text: [calm, quiet, serious] Every time you respawn, something stays behind.
events.note: the original take

Shot 5 (24 mm, a smooth vertical crane drop down through the grid layers): dozens of dark cubes rain down from the upper layers like dark snow, spiralling into a churning pitch-black core of corrupted blocks pulsing with faint magenta cracks far below; no head, no arms, no face

events.name: noob_where
events.note: the original take; the Noob leans over the pad's edge, his smile fading, worried brows
the core turns, magenta static pulsing; the cubes keep falling into it
Shot 6 (45 mm medium past a glowing hologram trio: Steve, the Noob and Patch reaching helplessly toward a looming jagged black-and-magenta void fissure; horizontal scanlines, a Fresnel edge)

events.name: noob_us
events.note: the original take; Shot 7 (65 mm close-up on the Noob): he blinks slowly, brows furrowed, a solemn open mouth that moves with the words

events.name: patch_last
events.note: the original take (its own solo recording); on the Noob's face: worried brows, a solemn mouth, no smile

Shot 8 (24 mm, one continuous crane pullback, high and wide): hundreds of glowing memory cells stretching into the fog, each slightly different (four poses, turned), each shadowed by its own dark fissure

events.name: steve_times
events.text: How many times have we done this?
events.direction_text: [calm voice finally cracking, shaken, quiet] How many times have we done this?
events.note: the original take; his quiet voice over the vastness
the pullback ends on the infinite field fading into the cyan-navy mist
Shot 9A (85 mm, shallow focus: Patch alone, centred, the grid blurred behind): Patch exhales

events.name: patch_count
events.note: the original take; his cyan eye dims ~40%, flickers once, drops ~5 degrees (exhaustion)
Shot 9B (50 mm two-shot): the Noob looks out over the endless ghosts of himself; Steve glances over at him with quiet guilt (Ep8's secret)

events.name: noob_deleted
events.text: I don't want to be deleted.
events.direction_text: [scared, trembling, quiet, almost crying] I don't want to be deleted.
events.note: the original take; he lowers his hands, small and genuinely scared
a held beat in the hall; the piano breathes; the HUD flickers

Shot 10 (28 mm wide, low): jagged black-and-magenta cracks rip across the glowing floor under their feet, the memory pads round them shatter, nearby hologram cells dissolve into black; the piano cut dead under a crystalline shatter and a sub-bass tear; REALITY 52 -> 30

events.name: patch_archive
events.text: It found the archive- I only have one stable coordinate left!
events.direction_text: [alarmed, urgent, fast] It found the archive- I only have one stable coordinate left!

Patch flares bright cyan, an emergency warp ring expanding from his chassis round all three
the whole frame flashes white-cyan: hard cut into Ep8's sunset forest clearing (Steve's hidden mossy portal)
